blockedReasons.summary: No reviewed local chat session store is configured.
No reviewed config/path boundary exists for locating a local store.
No reviewed manifest schema, version, or migration policy exists.
Session reads require reviewed manifest, redaction, and content policy.
Session writes require explicit local persistence and rollback policy.
Deletion needs retention, confirmation, and recovery rules.
No versioned schema migration or rollback policy exists.
Stored content would require prompt, response, transcript, title, and summary redaction rules.

handoffRefs.summary: Base chat session remains inactive and does not persist state.
Session index remains empty and does not read a store.
Lifecycle create, restore, clear, close, and export actions remain disabled or blocked.
Stored title reads, generation, rename, and persistence remain disabled or blocked.
Transcript persistence and export remain disabled.
Preferences do not read or write store paths.

limitations: Data-only chat session-store policy fixture; no real local session store is configured or read.
No store path, private path, manifest body, session record, stored title, transcript, prompt, response, summary, model path, runtime log, secret, or token content is included.
No configuration file, environment value, session store, manifest, transcript, title, prompt, response, summary, attachment, artifact, model asset, private path, raw log, or hardware dump is read.
No session, transcript, title, policy, config, preference, artifact, or store file is written, deleted, migrated, persisted, imported, exported, compacted, or rolled back.
No model load, runtime execution, provider call, network call, pccx-lab invocation, systemverilog-ide invocation, or KV260 hardware access is performed.
This is not a release, tag, compatibility commitment, MCP, LSP, IDE, marketplace, telemetry, runtime, model, session-store, migration, or storage implementation.
